criteria.label: Valid application requirements under Schedule 1
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Confirm the correct form, visa application charge, application method, nomination linkage, applicant identity and all Schedule 1 validity requirements before lodgement.

criteria.label: Correct Subclass 186 stream selected
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
factsRequired: reason Labour Agreement stream is relied on
criteria.actionRequired: Confirm that Subclass 186 Labour Agreement is the correct pathway and that the matter is not being assessed under another 186 stream criteria.

criteria.label: Current location, visa status and lawful-status position
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Confirm the applicant’s current location, current visa status, visa expiry, any bridging visa implications and any condition or status issue before lodgement.

criteria.label: Time-of-application and time-of-decision requirements tracked
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Prepare a lodgement-readiness timeline identifying criteria that must be satisfied at application, nomination and decision stages.

criteria.label: Primary applicant identity and biographical consistency
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Obtain and review certified identity documents and reconcile names, dates of birth, passports and prior Department records.

criteria.label: Employer nomination exists or will be lodged for the applicant
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Obtain the nomination approval or draft nomination and confirm it is linked to this applicant, this occupation, this employer and this Subclass 186 Labour Agreement pathway.

criteria.label: Nomination approval and validity at time of decision
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Confirm the nomination is approved or capable of approval, remains valid at time of decision and is not affected by withdrawal, refusal or changed employer circumstances.

criteria.label: Nominating employer lawfully and actively operates
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Review ABN/ASIC records, business activity, trading evidence, financial position and operational records to confirm the employer lawfully and actively operates.

criteria.label: Adverse information about employer considered
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Obtain employer compliance declarations and review workplace, sponsorship, migration and regulatory history for adverse information before relying on the nomination.

criteria.label: Nominated position is genuine
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Prepare a nomination evidence brief showing genuine business need, role availability, organisation structure, reporting lines and operational justification.

criteria.label: Position is full time and available for required period
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Obtain the signed employment contract and employer confirmation that the position is full-time, ongoing/available for the required period and consistent with the nomination.

criteria.label: Position not created primarily to secure migration outcome
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
factsRequired: business need independent of migration outcome
criteria.actionRequired: Obtain objective business evidence showing the role exists for genuine operational need and was not created primarily to facilitate a migration outcome.

criteria.label: Employment contract reflects genuine role and lawful conditions
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Review the signed contract against the nomination, Labour Agreement, NES/award or enterprise agreement, salary, duties, hours and ongoing role requirements.

criteria.label: Executed Labour Agreement is current and applicable
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Obtain the executed Labour Agreement/DAMA and confirm it is current, applies to the employer, and supports a Subclass 186 nomination for this role.

criteria.label: Occupation covered by Labour Agreement
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Confirm the nominated occupation is expressly covered by the Labour Agreement and any DAMA/occupation list conditions are satisfied.

criteria.label: Nomination complies with Labour Agreement terms
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Check the nomination against the exact Labour Agreement terms, including occupation, location, salary, concessions, limits and any special conditions.

criteria.label: Labour Agreement concessions identified and evidenced
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Identify every concession relied upon and obtain written evidence that the Labour Agreement permits that concession for this occupation and applicant.

criteria.label: Age requirement or Labour Agreement age concession
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Confirm whether the standard age requirement is met or whether a Labour Agreement age concession lawfully applies, and retain evidence of the concession basis.

criteria.label: English requirement or Labour Agreement English concession
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Verify the original English test result, eligible passport exemption or Labour Agreement English concession before final lodgement advice.

criteria.label: Skills, qualification or experience concession under Labour Agreement
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Confirm whether standard skills/qualification requirements apply or whether the Labour Agreement permits a lawful skills concession for this occupation.

criteria.label: Salary or AMSR concession under Labour Agreement
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Confirm whether any salary/AMSR concession is permitted by the Labour Agreement and reconcile it against the contract, guaranteed earnings and market evidence.

criteria.label: Nomination ceiling, location and limit conditions under Labour Agreement
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Confirm the nomination is within any Labour Agreement ceiling, location, occupation or cap/limit conditions before lodgement.

criteria.label: Employer compliance with Labour Agreement obligations
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Review employer compliance with the Labour Agreement, sponsorship obligations and workplace-law settings before relying on the pathway.

criteria.label: Occupation and duties align with nominated occupation
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Prepare a duties and occupation matrix showing that the actual role aligns with the nominated occupation and agreement occupation coverage.

criteria.label: ANZSCO or agreement occupation classification defensible
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Confirm the occupation classification relied on in the nomination is defensible by reference to actual duties, seniority and technical functions.

criteria.label: Qualifications and employment history support the role
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Build a verified employment and qualification chronology supported by qualifications, references, contracts, payslips, tax and superannuation records.

criteria.label: Registration, licensing or professional membership if required
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Obtain and review any registration, licence or professional membership required for the nominated occupation before lodgement.

criteria.label: Applicant work rights and employment compliance history
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Reconcile employment history against visa conditions, work rights, payroll, tax and superannuation records to identify any compliance issue.

criteria.label: Salary, AMSR and guaranteed earnings evidence
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Reconcile guaranteed earnings, contract salary, payroll, AMSR/market evidence and any Labour Agreement concession before relying on the salary position.

criteria.label: Employment terms and conditions are appropriate
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Review the employment terms against the Labour Agreement, nomination, NES, award/enterprise agreement, hours, duties and salary obligations.

criteria.label: Market salary or concession evidence is defensible
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Prepare market salary evidence or concession evidence showing the nominated salary is defensible under the applicable legal/agreement settings.

criteria.label: English evidence, exemption or concession verified
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Verify English eligibility using original test results, passport exemption evidence or a Labour Agreement concession that applies to the occupation/applicant.

criteria.label: Skills, qualifications and experience for nominated role
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Verify skills, qualifications and experience against the role and any Labour Agreement requirements or concessions before lodgement.

criteria.label: Health criteria / public interest health requirements
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.pdfSection: 7. Public interest, integrity and migration history
criteria.actionRequired: Review health disclosures and arrange required health examinations before final lodgement advice.

criteria.label: Character requirements including police/court history
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.pdfSection: 7. Public interest, integrity and migration history
criteria.actionRequired: Obtain and review Australian and overseas police certificates, court records and character disclosures before lodgement.

criteria.label: PIC 4020 and information/document integrity
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.pdfSection: 7. Public interest, integrity and migration history
criteria.actionRequired: Review all forms, declarations and supporting documents for consistency, authenticity and any false or misleading information risk.

criteria.label: Special Return Criteria and exclusion issues
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.pdfSection: 7. Public interest, integrity and migration history
criteria.actionRequired: Confirm whether any Special Return Criteria, exclusion, removal, deportation, debt or re-entry issue applies before lodgement.

criteria.label: Prior refusals, cancellations and compliance history
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.pdfSection: 7. Public interest, integrity and migration history
criteria.actionRequired: Obtain a full visa history and review any refusals, cancellations, condition breaches or compliance issues before final advice.

criteria.label: Consistency across forms, nomination, contract and evidence
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.pdfSection: 7. Public interest, integrity and migration history
criteria.actionRequired: Cross-check the application, nomination, contract, employer records, duties, salary and applicant evidence for consistency before lodgement.

criteria.label: Translations, certification and document quality
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.pdfSection: 7. Public interest, integrity and migration history
criteria.actionRequired: Ensure all non-English documents are translated by NAATI where required and all copies are certified or otherwise acceptable.

criteria.label: Family members and secondary applicants identified
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Confirm whether any family members are included and collect identity, relationship and dependency evidence for each included applicant.

criteria.label: Secondary applicant health, character and dependency criteria
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Check health, character, identity and dependency requirements for each included family member before lodgement.

criteria.label: Evidence sufficiency and lodgement readiness
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Assemble a criterion-by-criterion evidence brief and do not lodge until all critical evidence gaps are resolved and reviewed.

criteria.label: Manual migration-agent review before lodgement recommendation
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: A registered migration agent must review the original evidence, current law and final instructions before any lodgement recommendation is issued.

criteria.label: Labour Agreement stream gate confirmed
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: Confirm the matter is being assessed under the Labour Agreement stream and exclude other stream assumptions unless separately instructed.

criteria.label: No reliance on other 186 stream or TRT assumptions
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
factsRequired: No reliance on other 186 stream or TRT assumptions
criteria.actionRequired: Assess the matter under the actual Labour Agreement terms rather than standard other 186 stream assumptions.

criteria.label: Direct Entry skills assessment requirement
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: For Direct Entry only, verify the skills assessment requirement, assessing authority, validity and nominated occupation alignment.

criteria.label: Direct Entry skilled employment experience requirement
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
factsRequired: Direct Entry skilled employment experience requirement
criteria.actionRequired: For Direct Entry only, verify the required skilled employment experience and supporting references.

criteria.label: Direct Entry occupation eligibility and list requirement
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
factsRequired: Direct Entry occupation eligibility and list requirement
criteria.actionRequired: For Direct Entry only, confirm the occupation is eligible under the current instrument/list settings.

criteria.label: TRT qualifying visa and pathway requirement
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
factsRequired: TRT qualifying visa and pathway requirement
criteria.actionRequired: For TRT only, confirm the qualifying visa, nominated occupation continuity and employer relationship requirements.

criteria.label: TRT required employment period with sponsor
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
factsRequired: TRT required employment period with sponsor
criteria.actionRequired: For TRT only, reconcile the required employment period using payroll, tax, superannuation and visa records.

criteria.label: TRT sponsor/employer continuity
criteria.sourceCategory: Migration Act / Migration Regulations / Schedule 1 / Schedule 2 / legislative instruments / PAM
criteria.actionRequired: For TRT only, confirm sponsor/employer continuity and any transitional settings before lodgement.

Labour Agreement: remain offshore at time of application and grant
Direct Entry: Labour Agreement concession applies unless expressly selected
TRT qualifying employment unless TRT selected
Temporary Residence Transition: Direct Entry skills assessment unless separately required
